exclusions.title: Before images and repeated photos
exclusions.reason: Omitted six yellow before slides from House & Home, one HM before slide, old/preparation views from Hilltop and KV, and before-only Casa Bella views. Known reposts and duplicate image sizes count once. Distinct framings and one before/after panel remain.

exclusions.title: Houzz: siding that is still primer
exclusions.reason: The homeowner explicitly says the pictured cement-board siding is unpainted primer. The visual resemblance does not establish Evergreen Fog.

exclusions.title: Houzz: color advice and subsequent change to Retreat
exclusions.reason: Discussion and reference images do not establish a completed Evergreen Fog house. A commenter says they changed the applied Evergreen Fog to Retreat.

exclusions.title: Mod & Mood comparison colors
exclusions.reason: The article also displays Rosemary and Benjamin Moore Carolina Gull exteriors. Those are excluded; only its attributed Evergreen Fog porch is included.

exclusions.title: Setting for Four exterior illustration
exclusions.reason: The exterior image is an architectural-style rendering, not a documented photograph of completed paint.

exclusions.title: Pontata inspiration compilations
exclusions.reason: Known PLAN Home photos repeat here. Other house/door inspiration images have no verified real project record and several have synthetic visual characteristics. One image labeled house is an interior. Unverified generated-looking images are excluded.

exclusions.title: AI paint visualizations
exclusions.reason: Explicitly AI paint visualization. PaintVue, Facade Colorizer and similar recoloring/rendering results are not real applied-paint evidence.

exclusions.title: Villa Portofino color estimates
exclusions.reason: The gallery describes its Sherwin-Williams names as nearest visual matches inferred from photographs, rather than records of the paint actually applied. Those labels do not verify SW 9130.

exclusions.title: JC Julio general color palette
exclusions.reason: Evergreen Fog appears in a general color-swatch section; the site does not connect it to the pictured exterior project.

exclusions.title: Liberty Homes: Heber social-post lead
exclusions.reason: A builder caption describes Evergreen Fog siding with cream and stone accents at a Heber home. Further photo retrieval was blocked; retained as a source link, not counted as a saved photograph.

exclusions.title: Reddit homeowner lead
exclusions.reason: The indexed title refers to an Evergreen Fog exterior. The post required a human-verification challenge, so its photo could not be examined or included.

exclusions.title: Highland Homes Westin II lead
exclusions.reason: Search indexing lists Evergreen Fog as an accent. The current URL returned the general homepage, so the exact image-to-palette match was not recovered.

exclusions.title: Planning schedules and color proposals
exclusions.reason: Paint schedules, proposed elevations, swatches and color-selection questions are not counted as photos of completed paint. Only sources connecting the color to a photographed real project qualify for the main set.

methodology: Searched public web and image results for Evergreen Fog, SW 9130/SW9130, house, exterior, siding, stucco, painting, before/after and door terms. Checked contractor portfolios, builder articles, homeowner posts, manufacturer features, Houzz albums, Instagram carousels, Reddit leads and secondary design publications. Traced credits where possible, inspected collected images, removed known reposts and before-only photos, and kept distinct angles and labeled comparison/stage images. Source-confirmed means an original project source names the applied paint; it is not a guarantee of paint chemistry or camera color accuracy. The nine confirmed projects include 25 image assets; one asset is a before/after panel. Additional attributions include one project-palette inference. Private, deleted, unindexed, login-restricted and otherwise inaccessible posts may contain more photographs. This is a thorough public-web collection, not a claim to every photo in existence.
